answer: According to arXiv 2607.07612, the Singapore Agentic AI MGF's approach to risk classification focuses on types of negative consequences arising from agent malfunction, whereas the EU AI Act classifies risk into categories such as unacceptable, high, limited, and minimal risk. The four governance dimensions recommended by the Singapore Agentic AI MGF are: "assess and bound the risks upfront," "make humans meaningfully accountable," "implement technical controls and processes," and "enable end-user responsibility."
